correctness.rationale: Insertion/deletion distance on adjacent nonempty factors with total length L is L−2 LCS, giving the strict integer test 20 LCS < 9L. All earlier endpoints survive extension, so the new right endpoint suffices, and a missing length 33 also excludes every greater length. The canonical first-occurrence renaming is unique; no reversal quotient is used. I independently enumerated all labeled extensions with a bit-parallel LCS implementation cross-checked against explicit intersections of short subsequence sets. A split was skipped only when even its shorter side had length strictly below the forbidden threshold. The labeled counts at lengths 8, 31, 32, 33 were 78, 66, 60, 0. Normalizing the 60 length-32 words by all six letter permutations gave exactly the ten strings in RESULT.md, all using three letters. Replay: python3 /workspace/review-replay.py 2. This is an exhaustive finite computation and not a theorem about the optimal infinite-word parameter.
